task.ques: Locate a round-trip flight from Buenos Aires to Beijing, leaving on June 28, 2027, and returning on July 3, 2027, check out one of the options and tell me if the airline for my return flight is the same as my departure flight.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: No—the selected Buenos Aires–Beijing round trip uses KLM outbound on June 28, 2027 (EZE–PEK via Amsterdam), and Air France returning on July 3, 2027 (PEK–EZE via Paris). Google Flights’ “Selected flights” summary shows KLM beside “Mon, Jun 28” and Air France beside “Sat, Jul 3”; see final.png.
